title: Eastern Strait of Hormuz — October 13, 2026
text:
Eastern Strait of Hormuz — October 13, 2026"

"Iranian Army Navy: Non-Compliant Oil Tanker Catches Fire East of the Strait of Hormuz"

"Public Relations of the Iranian Army Navy:"

"At noon today, a non-compliant oil tanker that had switched off its tracking systems and was attempting to pass through a prohibited area in the eastern Strait of Hormuz was detected by the Iranian Army Navy’s surveillance teams after it suffered damage and caught fire."

"The Navy of the Islamic Republic of Iran Army, with a new formation and operational units deployed in the eastern Strait of Hormuz, the Arabian Sea, and the Sea of Oman, maintains full situational awareness and keeps all enemy activities and vessel movements under constant, real-time monitoring."

"All vessels must comply with international law, strictly refrain from turning off their electronic equipment, and coordinate with the Armed Forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran for safe passage."

"Source: Public Relations Office of the Islamic Republic of Iran Army Navy
